SELECT ra.id, ra.order_id, ra.user_id, ra.reason, ra.reason_category_id, rrc.name AS reason_category_name, ra.status, ra.remark, ra.refund_amount, ra.apply_time, ra.audit_time, ra.merchant_audit_time, ra.admin_audit_time, ra.refund_time, o.order_no, u.username FROM refund_application ra LEFT JOIN `order` o ON ra.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON ra.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `refund_reason_category` rrc ON ra.reason_category_id = rrc.id
AND ra.status = #{queryDTO.status}
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryDTO.orderNo}, '%')
ORDER BY ra.apply_time DESC
